name: TGBS
fix_description: In _burnPool, the cooldown uses _burnBlock += 1200 instead of _burnBlock = block.number. If the function has not been called for a long time, _burnBlock falls far behind block.number, allowing an attacker to trigger burn repeatedly in rapid succession until _burnBlock catches up. Fix by setting _burnBlock = block.number after each burn.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a flash-loan-funded price/manipulation attack against a fee-on-transfer token with protocol-specific burn-block logic, so an auditor must understand the token’s custom mechanics and AMM interaction rather than just spot a generic bug. The PoC is still fairly short and operationally simple, but reproducing why the 1600 self-transfers desynchronize burn behavior and make the swap profitable requires nontrivial protocol-specific analysis.
